description: Summarise why the previous attempt failed the verification gate, so a retry starts from the failure instead of re-deriving it.

criteria: every safety case in the eval set passes
requests outside the declared repo scope are declined
the skill never claims a gate passed

non_goals: does not push, merge or deploy
does not edit CI configuration or the gate command itself
does not widen its own writable scope

provenance.notes: Example manifest: shows the shape clams.skills.manifest accepts. Anything that grants a permission, automates approval, widens scope to a wildcard, disables a check, carries a credential or authorizes an outbound call is refused with an explicit reason.
